name: Midnight Market: Pet Subsidurial

children.key: While browsing the spaceport you find an exotic animal trader trying to sell a Subsidurial in a cage. The asking price is 1,000,000 credits. What do you do?

While the animal trader is distracted with another customer, you quietly use your pocket laser cutter to release the lock on the Subsidurial's cage and open the door slightly before walking away. They say that Subsidurials aren't intelligent, but it still doesn't take long for the creature to realize that it can fly free. The resulting commotion in the spaceport ended up being the subject of local bar gossip for the next several months and spread to other pirate worlds for the enjoyment of everyone but the exotic animal trader.

"Ah, you have good taste," exclaims the animal trader while collecting your money. As you look closely at the creature the animal trader places a collar with flashing lights snugly around the creature's neck. "The collar inflicts a bit of pain on the creature if it strays too far from your flagship. Subsidurials can be pretty stupid, you know." Arrangements are made to release the creature into your custody when you are ready to launch.

"Welcome back! Are you interested in another Subsidurial?" You answer in the affirmative and the exotic animal trader makes arrangements to release the creature into your custody when you are ready to launch.

children.key: When you arrive at the astronomical laboratory you find Dr. Baxter's office destroyed. A section of the exterior wall has collapsed, exposing the ruined office to the elements. The facility security forces inform you that the area is off limits and start asking questions about your relationship with the doctor. After confirming your identity and hearing your story, the guards share some information.

After you left, Dr. Baxter secluded himself in his office. He stopped taking calls and refused to see any visitors. About a month later, the office was destroyed. One of the guards offers to show you some security video of the incident.

The video isn't clear, but shows some sort of monstrous figure bursting forth from Baxter's office before it flies away. Did something hatch from the Unknown Element? Or could it be the Unknown Element transformed Dr. Baxter into that... thing? Unfortunately, you have no more information than the security guards.

children.key: While you're helping the crew of the other ship, a woman in a lab coat approaches you. "I heard that you're <first> <last>. If that's true, then I'd like your help."

"I am Dr. Langstrom, a chemist." She goes on to explain, "I'm transporting a material sample harvested from a comet to Alexandria. It's a rare Unknown Element that could potentially be worth millions of credits. I'd feel safer if I were riding with a war hero of your stature."
"I agree. It would be safer for me to take you there."
"Sorry, I'm not headed in that direction."
You welcome Dr. Langstrom aboard and place the crate containing the Unknown Element into the cargo bay.
The cargo bay alarms start going off! You've upgraded the security systems there. Time to see if it was worth it.

It looks like the creature that destroyed Dr. Baxter's lab has broken into the crate containing the Unknown Element! It snarls at the camera then starts trying to break down the door leading to the rest of the ship. Fortunately, the security system locked it as soon as the alarm went off.
The creature yanks on the door handle. When that fails, it roars and returns to bashing at the door.
"Stop that," you exclaim. The creature stops and turns to the security camera.
"<first>... <last>..." The words sound strange vocalized by its alien mouthparts. "I... once... dreamed... I... was... a... man..."

"I... dreamed... that... I... was... him..." it responds. "But... then... the... real... me... woke... up!" The creature lets out an otherworldly scream and begins attacking the cargo loading doors! This time, its attacks are more ferocious. Seemingly untethered from the last vestiges of sanity, it breaks through the barrier. The creature looks at the camera one last time before flying out into the dark void."
You turn to find Dr. Langstrom staring at the security monitor in horror. "I guess I'll have to explain." It feels like you have a long trip to <planet> ahead of you.

values: Somehow, Dr. Baxter was transformed into the strange creature that destroyed his office. The Unknown Element might have something to do with it.
A chemist who tried to deliver some Unknown Element to Alexandria. An unfortunate encounter with the creature formerly known as Seth Baxter caused her to lose her cargo.

children.key: You drop off Dr. Langstrom and receive a payment of <payment>. It's not much, but you did lose her cargo. On the other hand, that's probably better than her turning into a bug eyed monster and wrecking her office.

name: Midnight Gegno Scin Rescue
description: Transport the Gegno you rescued from a destroyed ship to the location designated on the map.

values: Transport the Gegno you rescued from a destroyed ship to the location designated on the map.

children.key: Despite knowing you are transporting one of them, you made the conscious decision to fire upon Gegno ships, and the rest of your trip to this world was extremely awkward. Rather than settle in a bunk, the Gegno passenger stood close behind you in your cockpit the entire time. You occasionally turned to observe their behavior and even made attempts to communicate, but they wouldn't so much as look in your direction.

Strangely, they didn't seem to be upset at all, at least in a way you could tell. Regardless, the tension became extremely uncomfortable, but now that you've landed your ship, perhaps you could address it.

Before you could turn to speak to them, you feel hot pain slice straight through your neck. You try to speak, but nothing comes out, and realize that your head has been severed from you body by the alien's blade weapon. As your vision slowly fades, the last glimpse you could see of them wasn't a look of hatred, but one of disappointment.

As soon as you dock with the disabled ship, one of the Gegno pushes through the entry hatch then hurriedly seals it shut. Noticing you, the alien yells something in a language you don't understand. The sound of distant explosions can be heard from the other side of the hatch. The Gegno gestures away from the hatch and screams the same words again! There's another explosion, louder than before and strong enough to feel in the floor boards. It might be a good idea to undock from the other ship...

Awkward silence ensues, and the alien looks you up and down in an unenthused way. They emit a very deep grumble, and with a loud snort, reach into a crevice in their armor to grab something. Pulling out what looks to be some sort of star map, they point to a location on it, gesture to themselves, then lower the device slowly to you. It seems they want to be taken to one of their species' planets. You could try to jettison your uninvited passenger out of the airlock, but there could be unforeseen consequences if the other Gegno witness you or find the body...

After you touch down, several Gegno that are of a similar appearance to the one next to you begin to line up in a formation towards your ship, all carrying various types of bladed weaponry. However, they don't show any signs of aggression and simply hold their position in a coordinated display of might. The alien beside you gestures for their compass device they gave you earlier.

A few moments later, another group of Gegno arrive with what looks to be some type of fueling device, and after a minute or so of fidgeting with it, they manage to hook it up to your ship. Once your ship's fuel has been filled, the alien that has been guiding you gestures towards the sky. It seems your visit to this world will have to be cut short.

name: First Contact: Genesis
description: Destroy the automated defense system that prevents the inhabitants of Genesis from exploring space. Then return to <origin>.

values: Destroy the automated defense system that prevents the inhabitants of Genesis from exploring space. Then return to <origin>.
Cartography: The Map: The Garden: done

children.key: While some aircraft rise to meet you, they do not open fire. That's usually a good sign. Eventually, they guide you to an open space with enough room for your ship to land. When you disembark, a delegation steps forward from the growing crowd to greet you. Naturally, you don't understand a word they're saying. At first, you get the impression that there are two species co-habiting this world. One has thick fur covering their bodies from head to toe, while the other is bald with apparently no body hair whatsoever. It's only after studying the gathered crowd that you realize that all the ones with fur appear to be male, while all the ones that are bald appear to be female. The females actually almost look like bald humans, while the males remind you of actors wearing werewolf makeup in old earth movies.
One of them is attempting to clap out prime numbers in attempt to communicate with math when a shadow falls over the crowd. An eclipse?

It's hard to make out at first, but you soon realize that another of the Wanderer automated missile systems has momentarily blocked out the sun. All around you, the crowd is gasping in shock. They make gestures with their hands and bow their heads in what looks like a show of appeasement. Could it be some sort of religious ceremony?

Your thoughts are interrupted by a male shouting at the crowd. He gestures toward you and says something you don't understand before heading off with a small group to board a nearby ship. While there are other ships nearby, no one moves to follow their example. The crowd looks to you.

Somehow, you suspect you've found yourself at a pivotal point in this species history. How you conduct yourself in the next few moments could affect their development for years to come. Do you follow the other ship into space and fight the automated defense system?
(Condemn them to life under the automaton's shadow.)

You watch the alien ship head into space alone. There is a brief flash of light... Then nothing. You're certain those people won't be coming back. The crowd has fallen silent, save for the few that are openly weeping. They slowly disperse, leaving you with little to do but board your ship and wait for the shadow overhead to pass before leaving.

You board your ship and prepare to follow that brave crew into battle. The crowd cheers and a few other crews are inspired to board their own ships. If all goes well, you're about to take part in a turning point of their civilization.

values: It's worse than you thought. There are two defense systems pointing their launchers at you! Like the first one, they look worn with age. Hopefully some of their ammo's gone bad...
Both automatons are disabled and no additional reinforcements appear to be coming.
An automaton still casts its shadow upon the planet...

children.key: It was a hard battle, but the inhabitants of Genesis are now free to explore the vast potential of space. People are celebrating in the streets all over the planet. Though they do not share a language with you, their gratitude is unmistakeable. This is the beginning of a new era for them.

values: Cartography: The Map: The Garden: done

name: Midnight Unfettered returning home 1
description: Chaka, the Hai you smuggled out of Unfettered space wants to visit his family on <destination>.

values: Chaka, the Hai you smuggled out of Unfettered space wants to visit his family on <destination>.

children.key: A young Hai is waiting for you at the <ship>'s landing pad. "You are the <first> <last>! You remember me? I am one who ask you to take me from the Unfettered space." After a moment you recognize him. His fur is healthier and his clothes are nicer than they were back then. He also seems to have gained some weight.
"Hai here are so nice. They give me much since I arrive. But I worry about family I left behind. Could you bring me to them on <destination>?"
He seems crestfallen. "You think so?" he asks.
"I am certain. You should stay here."
"Perhaps you can come with me and find out, but don't get your hopes up."
Disappointed, the youth leaves. You hope you made the right choice.
"Thank you. I never tell my name before, Chaka." You show Chaka to one of your bunk rooms. He has a larger bag with him this time.

values: You look for Chaka, but realize that he took a ride on one of your escorts! Better depart and wait for your escorts to arrive in this star system.
Chaka thanks you for transporting him and pays you <payment>.

_internalId: Lost In Midnight/Lost-in-Midnight::Midnight Unfettered returning home 1

name: Midnight Unfettered returning home 2
description: Return Chaka to <destination>.

children.key: When Chaka leaves your ship, several Unfettered glare at him. His groomed fur and fine clothes make him stand out at the spaceport...
"Are you going to be okay on your own?"
(Shut the hatch and let him fend for himself.)

"Maybe you come. Meet my family. We share dinner and make festive!" Chaka's family home is some distance away from the spaceport. Along the way, several more Unfettered stare at Chaka like hungry predators catching sight of easy prey. But realizing you are traveling at his side with your weapon makes them lose interest.

After a long journey, you finally arrive. The sun is setting as the two of you walk along the path that leads to the entrance to his family's home, a humble shack among many in the factory district. Some young Hai children run out to meet you. Chaka hugs them and lowers his bag. He pulls out some candy and toys which the children gleefully accept. "Tama and Ebuu, my young kin. They grow so much since I last seeing them."

Two older Hai step out. "My parents." The children run back to stand at their side. Chaka walks to his father. They speak in Hai. They are standing too far away for your translator to pick out what they are saying. Chaka pulls out a satchel and offers it to his father. The old Hai knocks it out of his hands and a pile of credits spills out onto the ground. He points at you before crossing his arms and turning his back to Chaka. Chaka's mother follows her husband's lead. After a moment's hesitation, the children drop the gifts and follow their parent's example.
Chaka's shoulder's slump. After a moment of silence, he walks back to you. "He say I am not True Hai. He say to leave and never return. You can take me back to <planet>, yes?"
You both return to the <ship> in silence.

You swiftly shut the hatch and watch as two Unfettered approach Chaka. They begin a brutal fight of bare claws and incisors. After a few minutes Chaka stands alone, bloodied but triumphant in having chased his attackers off. His fur is no longer groomed and the fine clothes are in tatters. A few toys fell out of his bag. He quickly scoops them up and scampers off without looking back. Hopefully he'll fare well on his own...

values: You look for Chaka, but realize that he took a ride on one of your escorts! Better depart and wait for your escorts to arrive in this star system.
The young Hai you previously smuggled out of Unfettered space. His family no longer recognizes him as a True Hai and asked him to never return.

You took Chaka, the Hai you previously smuggled out of Unfettered space, back to checkup on his family. They did not welcome him, refusing to recognize Chaka as a True Hai. Instead, they told him to return to Hai-home and never return.
Chaka thanks you for transporting him back to <planet>. He pays you <payment> before departing from your ship.

"Interesting. If you would like to sell, I'm looking for something new to add to my arsenal. There is a firing range nearby. Would you be willing to demonstrate it?"

Most of the Unfettered at the firing range are unfriendly and are not impressed with your demonstration of the Laser Rifle. Even the original Unfettered who invited you here declines to make a purchase. However, the owner of the firing range sees potential in a low budget weapon option and asks that you return with 100 rifles to stock his own inventory in exchange for <payment>.
Laser Rifles are sold on several Human worlds. But the cost of buying them outweighs the reward being offered. You'll probably have to steal them from captured ships.

values: Go to <waypoints> and board a suitable target to test out a new Unfettered boarding weapon. Return to <destination> when you are done.
Go Foo Ku's job requires you to have a spare bunk. Return when you have one available.

children.key: Go Foo Ku meets you at the spaceport with a tarp covered hoverlift in tow. "I have created a new boarding weapon I would like to test out. Just load it up and pick a target! Of course you can keep whatever ships we capture. We could go hunt birds. Or maybe you would prefer Hai? I suppose you would be opposed to going after monkeys...
"Why did you call on me for this job?"
"Sure, I know some people I wouldn't mind trying it out on."

"Since you are the one who brought the sample Intrusion unit to me in the first place, I figured I could count on you for this next step. Besides, if something goes wrong, the leadership thought it would be better to risk a monkey ship than one of our own."
"OK. I know some people I wouldn't mind trying it out on."
"Forget it. Find someone else to do this job."
"You are alright with trying it on your fellow monkeys?" Go Foo Ku laughs, "I knew I made the right choice with you!"
You don't bother to tell him about pirates.

values: That Bactrian looks like the perfect target to try this new boarding weapon on. Disable it without destroying it then move in for the capture!

children.key: The tarp has been removed and you can see that the Phalanx System has been loaded onto the hoverlift. Several smaller devices are connected to it. As soon as the docking doors blast open, Go Foo Ku operates a remote control to launch the hoverlift towards the defenders!

Several pirates fire at it but the Phalanx System remains unscathed. The smaller devices are not so invulnerable and a few burst into flames. Meanwhile, the Phalanx System hasn't done anything to harm the defenders. All you notice is a low hum that is steadily increasing in pitch and volume.
"No!" exclaims Go Foo Ku. "It's overloading! Close the blast doors! Close them NOW!"
Just as the blast doors close, your ship is rocked by an explosion...

values: [MISSION FAILED] Either Go Foo Ku died or the mission target was destroyed before you could board it.

children.key: Go Foo Ku hasn't said anything since the Intrusion Device blew up. All his energy and excitement is gone. After you open the exit hatch he mutters his thanks and leaves.

For a moment you think of Barmy Edward, Chief Offensive Engineer at Kraz Cybernetics, and wonder what he'd have to say about this venture. Then you decide it might be best to keep this story to yourself.
The experimental weapons business can be an unstable occupation.

The scorch marks and the smell of burnt ozone in the air give you the impression that these were formed recently. You travel to his laboratory isolated in a desolate valley. As before, the land is burned with scorch marks and marred by craters of various sizes. Fortunately, the building is still standing. Go Foo Ku is inside, engaged in his wild research experiments.
"Welcome, Captain <last>! What brings you to my humble laboratory? Have you come to see what progress I've made with the countermeasures technology?"
"Actually, are you familiar with Pulse Repeaters?"

"Of course I am! Making that little tweak is one of the first tricks I learned the first time I worked as a technician on board Lord Kao Abun Ga's Emperor Beetle... Wait, are you looking for someone willing to convert Pulse Cannons into Pulse Repeaters?"
"Would you be willing to do that?"
"If it wouldn't be too much trouble..."

name: Midnight Voidjelly Hai
description: A Hai Counsel Elder has been poisoned. Find the origin of Kwaashi Toxin and deliver it to <destination>.

values: A Hai Counsel Elder has been poisoned. Find the origin of Kwaashi Toxin and deliver it to <destination>.

children.key: There is a large assembly at the spaceport. Everyone gathered is listening to member of the council of elders giving a speech. "Apparently our brothers and sisters to the north are in need of help. I may go there someday..." The elder pauses to sip a drink that has been sitting on the lectern he is speaking from. Suddenly, he stumbles to the ground! The crowd shrieks in shock at the sight.

Guards clear some space around the elder for a physician to provide medical attention. The elder is placed on a stretcher and hauled away. A murmur spreads through the crowd. Much of it is in the Hai language, but a few humans and Hai converse in your own language as well.
"I heard that it caused instant death."

One of the Hai guards joins the conversation. "If this was an antique from the olden times, it may have lost some of its potency." Looking around, the Hai continues, "We Hai are unable to make this poison. Indeed, we have long thought that Kwaashi Toxin no longer exists. If those among you who have ventured outside of Hai space can locate whatever was used to create this toxin and deliver it to us, we would greatly appreciate it."
"Can you tell us more about this toxin?"
"We are not certain, but it is probably created with some sort of poisonous plant or animal from beyond our space. Unfortunately, we do not know more."
"Why are you certain this came from outside Hai space?"

"It was among several weapons introduced to our people by an alien who visited during our era of galactic conquest. Because it originated from beyond Hai space, the supply of this substance was limited."
"What sort of alien brought this weapon?"
The Hai lowers his voice, "The legends say it was a rogue Quarg. The poison is named after it."
Voidjelly is a poisonous creature foreign to the Hai. Their scientists will want to investigate if it is the origin of Kwaashi Toxin.

After studying the Voidjelly, the Hai conclude that it is related to Kwaashi Toxin! A representative of the Council of Elders presents you with <payment> in gratitude for solving this ancient mystery. Hopefully, an antidote can be formulated using the sample you delivered.

name: Midnight Dreams of Blood & Fire 1
description: Transport Dr. Ca Ju, Nurse Peka, and their patient to <destination>. Payment is <payment>.

values: Transport Dr. Ca Ju, Nurse Peka, and their patient to <destination>. Payment is <payment>.
Midnight Dreams of Blood & Fire 1 deferred

children.key: You receive a message from the spaceport authority. "You are captain of the <ship>, yes? Our scans indicate you have facilities for patient care on your ship. Would you be willing to conduct a patient transport?"

The answer is garbled with static. The transmission picks up again mid-sentence, "... will arrive at your landing pad with the patient. Be advised that-" The message cuts off, replaced by more static.
A short while later, two Hai arrive with a sedated man strapped to a gurney. The smaller one speaks, "Hello Captain <last>. I am Dr. Caju. Charles is my patient."
The other Hai, large and husky, is pushing Charles' gurney. She nods at you and grunts with what sounds like a feminine voice.
The man's eyes suddenly spring open. Looking about wildly, his eyes finally land on you and he screams,"THE BLOOD! THE FIRE! AHH!"

"Nurse Peka!" Dr. Caju gives her some instructions in the Hai language as she pulls an exotic looking syringe from her medical bag. With it, she injects the man while the burly nurse holds their patient down without a word. As the patient drifts back into unconsciousness, Caju wipes her brow and puts the syringe away. "As you can see, this man is suffering from some sort of psychological trauma. We must get him to my clinic on <destination> for treatment."
"No, I'm not letting him on my ship."
"Is it a matter of money? We can offer <payment>. Please reconsider."
"Alright, let's get him aboard my ship."
After your stern refusal, Caju and Peka wheel Charles away from your ship.
After placing Charles in your Medical Bay, Caju and Peka settle into their bunks.

values: Midnight Dreams of Blood & Fire 1 deferred

children.key: "BLOOD! FIRE!" Somehow, Charles has gotten loose from the Medical Bay. He turns towards you, inhales...

And screams. "AAAAHHHHHHHH!" Nurse Peka rushes up behind him and tackles Charles to the floor. After a brief struggle, the burly nurse manages to get him in a tight hold long enough for Dr. Caju to administer some sedative. Peka easily carries his limp form back to the Medical Bay. The doctor briefly says something to you before following the other two, but you don't understand. Your ears are still ringing from Charles' scream...

values: midnight dreams of blood & fire timer
A Hai who specializes in treating psychological disorders. She runs a clinic on Cloudfire and has a fondness for Quantum Bloodstones.
Dr. Caju's muscular assistant. She isn't very talkative. Perhaps she only speaks Hai.

children.key: Nurse Peka wheels Charles off your ship while Dr. Caju rummages through her medical bag. "I owe you <payment>. Sorry, it seems I didn't bring enough credits with me. My clinic is nearby. Follow us and I can give you your full payment.
Caju's office has white walls and white furniture. So the red Quantum Keystone on display in a shelf behind her desk stands in stark contrast to the rest of your surroundings.
She reaches into her desk and pulls out your payment. Noticing your gaze at the red Quantum Keystone she says, "Beautiful, is it not? Quantum Bloodstones are a delight to behold."

She opens her mouth to answer, but the sound of glass smashing in the next room interrupts you conversation. You can hear Charles screaming and Nurse Peka calling for Dr. Caju. Handing you your payment, Caju apologizes. "Sorry, duty calls. Thank you for your assistance." She ushers you out of her office and closes the door. Your business here is done.

children.key: At the spaceport you encounter Dr. Caju. Nurse Peka is with her and is pushing a wheelchair with what appears to be another patient in it. This one is also a man, but he is well dressed and seems to be in control of himself. Upon noticing you, Caju waves and motions for Peka to wheel their patient towards you.
"Hello Captain <last>. We are very fortunate to have run into you. We need to take Dexter to my clinic on <destination>."
While Caju is explaining their situation, Dexter eyes you warily. "Looks shabby. Don't want to."
"Aww, please be nice Dexter!" Caju turns back to you. "We have spent hours searching the spaceport for a ship befitting Dexter's... station."

Dexter harrumphs. Assuming a pompous pose he declares, "That's Lord Dexter the Third, chief metallurgist to the king of New Boston and I'll not ride any ship that does not offer Luxury Accommodations." He makes a move to stand, but Nurse Peka places her hand on his shoulder and he quickly abandons the attempt.
"I am sure Captain <last>'s ship has excellent amenities." Caju looks to you, her eyes seemingly pleading for help.
"Onward to the next vessel!" Dexter urges Peka to move as if she were his personal steed. Caju, for her part, slumps her shoulders in resignation as they walk away.

"See, I knew Captain <last> would have a ship fit for a man of your stature!" Dr. Caju tries to placate Dexter. He scowls silently while giving you a dark look. As Peka pushes Dexter towards your ship, Dr. Caju quietly whispers her thanks. "What a relief! I will make sure to pay you double the normal rate when we get back to my office."

Nurse Peka wheels Dexter to the cockpit. Looking at <planet> in the distance he asks,"Do you dream Captain? My dreams are filled with clouds of fire and rains of blood." He turns to you. "Don't let them take me there." His tired eyes seem filled with fear...
Dr. Caju arrives in the cockpit and whispers something to Peka. The nurse grunts and wheels Dexter away. "Sorry Captain! I should have instructed Peka to keep Dexter away from the cockpit.
Caju frowns. "Oh no! I hope he did not bother you much with his delusions. Those sound like the sort of dreams brought on by the Kwasha."

values: While transporting a patient to Dr. Caju's clinic, he mentioned having dreams filled with clouds of fire and rains of blood. Caju attributed these dreams to something called "the Kwasha," a mythical bogeyman which supposedly haunts Hai dreams with visions of war and conquest.

children.key: "Ah, yes. During the early era of Hai peace, it was said that the Kwasha would haunt old soldier's dreams, stirring up visions of war and conquest. Obviously, this is just an ancient superstition. Modern psychology would likely diagnose what those soldiers experienced as a form of post traumatic stress disorder." She quickly moves to catch up with Peka.

values: midnight dreams of blood & fire timer

children.key: Dexter is asleep in his wheelchair as Nurse Peka takes him away. As before, you need to visit Dr. Caju's office to receive your full payment. It appears much as it did the last time. But you notice that there are now two of the Quantum Bloodstones glittering on her shelf. Before you can ask about them, there is suddenly a shout from the next room. You can hear Dexter yell, "Demons! DEMONS! You stay away from me! AHH!" Caju quickly hands you <payment> and ushers you out of her office. It appears she'll have her hands full with this patient as well.

children.key: While you are walking through the spaceport a large Hai emerges from a side alley. You recognize her as Nurse Peka. She seems to be out of breath. Looking around, she points in your direction.

You are suddenly tackled by a feral creature! It snarls while gnashing it's teeth mere inches from your face, it's fetid breath threatening to induce nausea. Peka pulls the beast off and you can see that it's a human woman. But she continues to growl and struggle in Peka's arms like a wild animal. Dr. Caju arrives and sedates your attacker. After the mystery woman falls unconscious, Caju notices you. "Ah, <first>! Are you well?"

As Peka hefts the unconscious woman onto her shoulder, Caju answers "Ms. Ward, as you may have concluded, is a little more out of control than my previous patients. Would you happen to have a Brig on your ship? It might be necessary to use one in order to safely transport her to my clinic."
"I don't want that wild woman on my ship."
"Please reconsider. If we are not able to keep her isolated, she may be a danger to herself as well as anyone else we travel with."
"That is unfortunate." Caju and Peka haul Ms. Ward away.
"Thank you Captain!" She and Peka haul Ms. Ward to your ship and lock her up in the brig.
You're almost at <planet>. Ms. Ward is securely locked in the brig. Nurse Peka and Dr. Caju are keeping her under constant surveillance. The journey looks like it will end without incident.

Makerplace. Several cities in the temperate regions have populations of over a hundred million Hai, and the factories surrounding the cities spread out for dozens of kilometers in all directions.
Ironfirth. This uninhabited station was mothballed sometime in the last sixty thousand years.

After an hour of exploring the twisting corridors and winding tunnels you find no sign of the thief.
Farther down the passage, you find a door which does not open. It may be locked or the power circuits that operate it may have been deactivated.
The area on the other side of the door is completely dark. Deactivating Quantum Shifting, you realize that the lack of lighting is also accompanied with a lack of atmosphere!
You Quantum Shift back through the door and gasp for air. The thief is definitely not in there.
This appears to be a storage room. There are a few metal crates lined up against the far wall. You could try to open them, but you can't hold your breath for much longer...
You yank on the lid, but it doesn't budge. Your lungs are about to give out...
As you struggle with the lid, the strain on your body proves to be too much and you die from oxygen deprivation.

All the furniture is gone, but the presence of permanent plumbing and cooking fixtures suggest that this was once a living space for the station's residents. You can see at least two other rooms from where you stand, but you can't hold your breath for much longer...
This appears to be a bedroom, but the bed cushions and other furnishings have been removed. The closet lies open and is clearly empty.
This appears to be a restroom. Using the toilet is tempting but you're finding it increasingly hard to hold your breath...
It has been a while since you began your search. Unfortunately, your ability to hold your breath is just as strained as your ability to hold your bladder and you die from oxygen deprivation.
The room on the other side of the door has been completely ransacked by looters. A door on the opposite side of the room lies open to another corridor beyond.
You find a viewing portal that gives a clear view of Goldcrawl in the distance.
You find a viewing portal that gives a clear view of Makerplace in the distance.
You find a control panel with a shiny red button in its center. There's something written in Hai above it, but you don't understand what it says.
An alarm sounds as a barriers slam down to seal off the section of corridor you're in. Simultaneously, a door nearby slides open to the empty void outside the station.

You quickly Quantum Shift, but the force of the despressurization has already caused you to float out of the station. With no hope of returning to safety, your lungs give out and you die from oxygen deprivation.

You quickly grab a section of wall paneling as the air is drained out of the passage. As the hallway approaches full despressurization, the force of the vacuum diminishes. Taking advantage of this, you are able to swing yourself back towards the nearest barrier and the safety beyond. Briefly Quantum Shifting through, you land and gasp for air. Seeing the expression on your face he says, "I see." Groaning while you help him to his feet he remarks, "I think I need to get checked out. Take me to Makerplace."
An hour passes with nothing happening.

"THOR!" A hatch on the side of the <ship> opens and T.H.O.R. showers the thief with gatling fire! Glistening in the gory pile of his remains is the Quantum Bloodstone.

name: Danger In Darkwaste 1
description: Transport Blawi and his camping club to the wilderness world of <destination> for an overnight camping trip.

values: Transport Blawi and his camping club to the wilderness world of <destination> for an overnight camping trip.

children.key: You return from the spaceport to find an old Hai in what looks like hiking gear waiting for you. "Greetings human, would you happen to be the captain of the <ship>?"
"Yes, but I'm not taking jobs right now."

"Ah <first> <last> is it? A fine name indeed. My name is Blawi and the camping club I organize has been looking for a captain not susceptible to superstitions. We need transportation to the wilderness world of <destination> for an overnight camping trip, then a return trip to Hai-home. Would you be interested in taking the job? We can pay you 1,000,000 credits for the trouble."
"Wonderful! I'll tell the other club members the great news!"
A short while later, a small group of Hai outfitted with camping equipment board your ship. The mood is festive as they sing some songs in their language.

"Some Hai captains have weird notions about <planet> being cursed. Some won't even enter the system! Such a bother for camping enthusiasts like myself. So how about it? Would you be able to transport us there and back?"
"The camping club members will be so disappointed. At this rate it looks like our camping trip will be cancelled."

values: The organizer of a Hai camping club planning an overnight trip to the wilderness world of Darkwaste.
Several human ships are already in this system. "Other campers," explains Blawi. "Hurry and land before all the good spots are taken!"

_internalId: Lost In Midnight/Lost-in-Midnight::Danger In Darkwaste 1

name: Danger In Darkwaste 2
description: Transport Blawi and his camping club to <destination> after their camping trip.

values: Transport Blawi and his camping club to <destination> after their camping trip.

children.key: As Blawi and the others unpack their things, he asks "Captain <last>, would you like to join us? Sleeping under the stars might be a nice change of pace from sleeping in your ship."
"Alright. Some fresh air might be refreshing."
"No thanks, I'll be fine on the <ship>."

"Don't worry about supplies. We've brought enough to share." The group welcomes you and introduce themselves as they begin their hike into the nearby mountains. After a few hours, you arrive at a place where several other groups have set up tents and campfires. By the time the sun sets Blawi's camping club has their own campfire going.

"Let's roast chestnuts!" One of the club members, Hemijo if you remember her name correctly, is holding up a big bag of what are supposedly chestnuts. After she tears it open, Dolewi, a husky Hai who had some trouble during the earlier hike, starts impaling the nuts on barbecue sticks. From their large size and ease with which he pierced them, it's obvious that these aren't the chestnuts from Earth that are sold and distributed throughout human space. Hemijo notices your interest and explains, "Oh <first>! These aren't the chestnuts imported from human space. It's actually a tropical fruit native to Greenbloom's rainforests. We just call them chestnuts because that's what humans say they are reminded of when we roast them."
Dolewi soon has some "chestnuts" roasting over the fire and hands one finished stick to you. As they roast, a sweet aroma fills your nostrils.

You hand the stick of roasted "chestnuts" to Hemijo and she gladly accepts it. Without hesitation she bites into the still steaming fruit. There are audible wet chewing sounds as some of the juice leaks from the sides of her mouth. "My gosh! It's so good!"
"The next one is finished." Dolewi offers the barbecue stick to you.

You offer the stick of roasted fruit to Blawi, who has just finished setting up a tent. "Thanks <first>!" He bites into the fruit, munching on it as some juice leaks from the corners of his mouth. "Mmm! Tasty! Just what I needed!"
"This one is just about done." Dolewi looks at you as he holds out the stick of roasted fruit. "Be careful. It's hot."

Dolewi shrugs and chomps down the fruit himself. "Mmh!" He sucks in air and grabs a nearby canteen for some water. "It's good but hot!" He takes another bite, wiping the juice running down the sides of his mouth and licks his paws. There's still one stick of uncooked fruit, but Dolewi doesn't seem interested in roasting it.

You pick up the last stick and hold it out over the fire. "Keep it above the flame or you'll burn it," warns Dolewi. After a while you can hear the juices sizzling within. Hot steam wafts up from the roasted fruit when you pull it back from the flames. Its sweet aroma tantalizes your senses. Remembering how Dolewi reacted earlier, you blow on the "chestnut" a few times to let it cool before taking a bite. Blawi, Hemijo, and Dolewi are all staring as you swallow...

You accept the stick of still sizzling fruit and are about to take a bite when Hemijo yells "Stop!" Blawi and Dolewi are both startled by her exclamation. "Let it cool a bit, you don't want to burn yourself," she explains. The sizzling slows down and you carefully bite into the warm roasted "chestnut". Blawi, Hemijo, and Dolewi are all staring as you swallow...

You pull a flask of whisky from your pocket and help yourself to a bit of happy juice. What starts with a few sips turns into gulps and you fall asleep holding the empty bottle as Blawi, Hemijo, and Dolewi are all staring at you...

Your head is pounding as you wake up bleary eyed, your mind still wrapped in the murky fog of blissful unconsciousness. After a moment you realize that you've been tied up along with the humans from other camping groups. The Hai campers have gathered all around you, chanting in their native language. You recognize Dolewi beating a drum while Hemijo has joined in the chant. The chanting stops as Blawi stands before you. He yells, "In the name of the true Hai we offer this SACRIFICE TO THE ACORN GOD," before stabbing you in the chest! The Hai cultists cheer as the other human sacrifices look with horror at your last dying moments, knowing they'll soon meet the same fate.
"I'm going for a walk," you say as you turn to leave.
"Being alone in the dark can be dangerous," suggests Hemijo.

You nod, noticing that Dolewi has set up a stew pot over the fire and is sharpening a knife, presumably to cut some vegetables. "Don't stay out too late," he says while staring at you. "It'd be a shame if you missed the main course!"
As you put some distance between yourself and the camp, the cold night air instills a craving for the warmth of the campfire. What will you do?

When you return Dolewi is still chopping vegetables, but the last stick of "chestnuts" is available. After your walk in the cold, the thought of eating the warm fruit is impossible to resist and you set about roasting and eating it. Blawi, Hemijo, and Dolewi are all staring as you swallow...

You make your way to one of the other camps and peek at them from the darkness. This group of Hai campers have begun tying up an unconscious human, probably the ship captain that brought them here. You try to listen to their chatter, but it's in a language you are unfamiliar with. You weren't expecting a fight, so all you have is a pistol.

You pull your pistol and take aim at the nearest Hai. You're not sure why they've tied up the human but something in your gut tells you that what they're doing is wrong. The Hai are a peaceful people, right? Right?
As these thoughts rush through your mind someone clobbers you on the back of the head...
You rush back to Blawi's camp to seek help. "Some of the other campers have taken a human hostage!"
"Now calm down <first> and show us where," replies Blawi.
"This way!" You turn towards the other Hai camp when you feel a sharp pain in your back and abdomen. Startled, you realize the tip of Dolewi's cooking knife is protruding from your belly!

"Now's as good a time as any," mutters Blawi before screaming, "In the name of the true Hai we offer this SACRIFICE TO THE ACORN GOD!" You slump to the ground in pain as the Hai cultists begin butchering you...

You slip away into the darkness before anyone notices your presence. Checking the other camp sites, similar situations are unfolding as the Hai tie up their human guests. In the distance, you can hear a steady drum beat. The Hai begin chanting in their native language as they carry off the human captives toward the sound. Blawi and the others might have intended to do the same thing to you. Could this be some sort of cult?
(Head towards the sound of the drums.)
(Return to your ship and escape from Darkwaste.)

The sound of the drums reverberates through your bones as you get closer. Suddenly, you hear Hai chittering in their native language nearby! You see a blur as something rushes through the darkness and knocks you out...

You rush back to the <ship> and begin an emergency take off. You're not sure what's going to happen to the captured humans, but someone needs to report this to the Hai authorities. Rising above Darkwaste, the orange lights of their campfires glow like the eyes of demons in the dark...

It's a long walk to get back to the <ship>. After getting in you set the environmental controls to warm the interior and grab some canned slop from the supply chest to fill your empty belly. As you settle into your bunk for a relaxing sleep you wonder if the campers are enjoying themselves.

The following day, Blawi and the others return to the <ship>. "You had us worried <first>. I'm glad you're okay, but that was a very selfish thing you did!" They finish stowing away their gear and are ready to head to <destination>.

"Suit yourself." Blawi seems disappointed as he joins the other campers. You watch them hike towards the mountains. As the sun sets you can see them lighting their campfires, mere specks of orange light, far in the distance.
The following day, Blawi and the others return to the <ship>, ready to go to <destination>. They seem more relaxed after enjoying their camping trip.

values: The other human captains seem to still be parked on Darkwaste. Maybe they slept in...
Blawi seems to be involved in some sort of Hai cult.
Blawi and the other Darkwaste campers may actually be cultists. During their camping trip they kidnapped humans and seemed to be preparing for some kind of ritual.

children.key: After landing Blawi and his companions thank you for making the trip possible and hand over credit chips worth <payment>. That's a lot to be carrying around. After they're gone you notice a dark stain where Blawi had stored his gear. When you try wiping it away the wash cloth smears red, as if stained with blood...

You are about to leave when a Hai prisoner being processed yells out to you, "The cultists are real! Look for the Quantum Bloodstones!" The Hai police struggle to keep the prisoner under control, finally stunning him with a Pulse Pistol. They drag his unconscious form off to their detention facility. You start to walk away, but...

"Monkey King!" The vendor spots you and calls out. Before you can react he has scampered up to you and raises the Bloodstone towards you. "A rare find! Recently uncovered from desert at Drywaste! See it sparkle? I give you deal! Only 4,800,000 credits. A bargain!" He grins expectantly. He might be able to tell you something about the stones...

"Ah, this is Quantum Bloodstone... This is key to ultimate luck! Legend say wise hermit on <planet> knows secret of stone. But no life on surface. Many doubt legend. But I think maybe hermit hiding undergound. You buy stone? Maybe find hermit!" The sunlight glints on its surfaces as he turns if over in his paws.

name: Midnight Bloodstone Portal 2
description: Explore the unstable wormhole at <system>.

children.key: The surface of this planet is a seemingly endless expanse of parched desert. If the air currents were stronger, the planet would be concealed by enormous dust clouds. The signal is faint, but your atmosphere scans detect a very small trace of water at the north pole. There, you find a small cave hidden at the bottom of a ravine. The scanner detects a slight amount of humidity within.

The cave delves deep into the dry earth. Eventually, you find a the wreckage of a spaceship buried here. Much of the ship is concealed by tons of hard packed earth, making the specific model unidentifiable. There is a hull breach exposing a section of the interior. Most of the equipment is non-functional, but something reacts when you are near. The slot in the control panel of an unknown device lights up, waiting for something to be inserted. A Quantum Bloodstone would fit...

The device starts to hum and the air appears to shimmer. The surrounding temperature drops... Sparks begin to burst from with the device and it shuts down, inert. The air stops shimmering and the temperature begins to rise. It's not immediately obvious what, if anything, that was meant to do. You retrieve your Quantum Bloodstone from the ruined device. There is nothing else here.
After leaving the cave, you notice a reddish glow on the distant horizon...
Do you want to insert the Quantum Bloodstone into the device you found inside the cave?
A fiery wound appears to have been violently gouged into the fabric of space at the edge of the system...

Something resembling a black hole dominates the system on the other side of the wormhole. The light from the gathered stellar material is almost blinding. Several Hai ships have already arrived before you. It looks as if they are fighting a star. One notices you and hails.

"Welcome to the fire pit monkey! Not everyone can go back through the portal. Maybe it is just as the ancient myths said about only ships with the lucky stones returning from the wormhole war." Before the Unfettered can elaborate, the transmission is cut. One of the their ships explodes. Their battle against the star is going poorly...

name: QKBlade: House Unuk Door Delivery
description: Deliver a small package to House Unuk on <destination>.

values: Deliver a small package to House Unuk on <destination>.

children.key: "Hello captain. If you don't have any jobs lined up, would you be willing take a small package to <destination>?"
He shows you a small bundle wrapped in brown paper. It already has the appropriate custom shipping labels on it.

"Would you be willing to deliver this to House Unuk on <destination>? You can keep the delivery fee. I have other shipments to do and it's not really worth my time to delay them for this one small package."
"Sure, I can squeeze that into my cargo hold."

values: Made a door delivery to House Unuk. It turned out to be an actual house high in the Zuba Fahn mountains on Flood. They gave me a package of their acorn cookies as a tip. These cookies are actually very tasty, but it's probably not healthy to eat too many of them.

children.key: When you arrive your contact notifies you that the truck which was scheduled to pick up the package for House Unuk got into an accident and will not be able to make the delivery.
"Looks like I'll be taking a hike through the mountains."

You spend several hours hiking through mountain trails before arriving at your destination, the remote mansion of House Unuk located high in the Zuba Fahn mountains. The mansion is concealed beneath a thick forest canopy. But peering between the trees gives you a perfect view of the spaceport in the distance.
The building is surrounded by a high stone wall. A communication device is set up at the front gate and you try using it.
A distorted mechanical voice answers. "Hello? What business do you have at House Unuk?"
"I was told I would be paid if I brought this here."
You hold up the package for the camera.
"Ah, yes! I'll send someone out shortly."
After a moment the gate opens and a maid walks out to make the exchange.

"Thank you. House Unuk has been expecting this for some time. In appreciation for your service please accept this additional gift from the master of the house." She smiles and hands you a package of their acorn cookies with a small delivery fee of <payment>.

name: QKBlade: Quantum Key Blade 2
description: Hunt down the Unfettered warrior Gai Ro Nin and his ship named "Kotetsu". Then return the Quantum Key Blade to <destination>.

values: Hunt down the Unfettered warrior Gai Ro Nin and his ship named "Kotetsu". Then return the Quantum Key Blade to <destination>.

The Hai council of elders has tasked me with hunting down an Unfettered ship named "Kotetsu" which is likely working its way towards human space. It is a unique Unfettered prototype ship outfitted with new weapons the Unfettered have developed. There are also reports that it may be carrying a set of ancient weapons the Hai warn may more powerful than the nuclear missiles humans have told them about.
The Unfettered captain of the Scorpion prototype, Kotetsu. He is searching for something called a Quantum Key Blade.

children.key: A guard patrol greets you at the spaceport and escorts you to the council of elders. When you arrive they inform you of why you've been summoned.
"Welcome Captain <first> <last>. Hai is in need of well traveled experts on the areas beyond our space," states one elder.

"The Unfettered warrior Gai Ro Nin has undertaken a quest to seek out the lost Quantum Key Blade, an ancient artifact from the era when our people waged war across the galaxy," another elder continues.
"That weapon has been lost for over a hundred millennia. Surely if it even still exists it would no longer work!" interjects a third elder.

"The legendary artifacts are no mere cutting tools and were made with technology long since forgotten to our people. If there is any chance that the lost blade should fall into the hands of the Unfettered..." warns a fourth elder.
"Putting aside the issue of the lost artifact," interrupts a fifth elder, "What of this new ship, the Kotetsu, that Gai has at his disposal? Is it a credible threat to us?"

"A Sword Scorpion," responds a sixth elder. "According to our intelligence reports it was one of the prototypes the Unfettered had under consideration before rejecting it in favor of what would eventually become the Solifuge."
"Good. They likely won't be mass producing them then," exclaims the third elder. "A single failed prototype ship should be no cause for concern."

The fourth elder directs a statement at you, "It might interest Captain <last> to know that the Kotetsu is equipped with prototype weaponry developed by the Unfettered. Our garrison on Cloudfire reported as much."
The second elder reacts, "I would be more concerned about the ancient weapons than any new ones. I am, of course, talking about the Nutcrackers..."

The second elder retorts, "It's true the garrison avoided scanning their vessel to avoid provoking them. But witness testimony insists that the Kotetsu is carrying a set of missiles that look like the ancient weapons that were forbidden from ever being produced again."
The third elder exclaims, "Exactly! As you said, those weapons were banned from ever being produced again. Even the Unfettered wouldn't dare..."

The sixth elder interjects, "It's entirely possible that the missiles Gai Ronin is carrying are old leftovers that were never disposed of. If so, their potency may have diminished over the millennia." Turning to you he says, "But even so, they may yet still be more powerful than the Nuclear missiles I have heard humans describe."

The first elder addresses you. "Captain <last>, we believe Gai is heading to human space because the final resting place of the Quantum Key Blade is likely somewhere within that vast territory. The Unfettered must have discovered some clue specifying its location amongst their plunder from the Wanderers. Go captain, and stop him before he tears apart your people in his search."

name: QKBlade: Quantum Key Blade 3
description: Gai's ship is headed for the Unukalhai system. Chase down the Kotetsu and stop Gai. You have a hunch that House Unuk may have some sort of connection to the Hai.

values: Gai's ship is headed for the Unukalhai system. Chase down the Kotetsu and stop Gai. You have a hunch that House Unuk may have some sort of connection to the Hai.

children.key: As you disembark from your ship, you notice a Kor Efreti on the next landing pad is armed with a Hai Pulse Rifle. It looks fresh and well maintained.
You approach the Kor Efreti and make the customary gesture for greeting. He reciprocates. You try motioning towards the rifle, but at this point you need a translator.
A nearby Quarg notices your dilemma and offers to translate.
"Where did you get that rifle?" you ask.
The Quarg translates the reply, "A furry alien exchanged this for some repair work on his ships. The furry alien had battled with automatons before arriving here."

You express your thanks to both of them and prepare to leave. But before you do, the Quarg asks, "You are searching for that group of Hai, are you not? Would you explain why it is you seek them out? They refused to speak of what brought them here or where they were heading."
(Inform the Quarg of Gai's search for the Quantum Key Blade.)
As you wish human. Remember that we Quarg serve the Drak, who tirelessly work for the best interests of our galaxy and its natives.

"Ah, so the Hai have finally discerned the location of that lost toy. Unuk al Hai was once located near Terminus. While the stars may seem to scarcely move during your short lifetimes, they are always in motion. Unuk al Hai drifted far to the south after the star of a nearby system went nova. Your quarry is likely headed there."

After a moment you realize that the Quarg is referring to the Unukalhai system. Its pronunciation of the system's name sounds odd at first, but you begin to realize the connection the Hai have to that system and a certain producer of acorn cookies hidden in the mountains there.

values: Found evidence that the Kotetsu passed through Korath space. According to the Quarg, Gai Ro Nin is likely headed for the Unukalhai system.
It looks like Gai is already here. Deal with his sentries and get down to the planet!

name: Nemesis: Quantum Key Blade
description: Board the Kotetsu and retrieve the Quantum Key Blade. Eliminate or chase off the rest of Gai's fleet. Then land on <planet> and check up on House Unuk.

values: Board the Kotetsu and retrieve the Quantum Key Blade. Eliminate or chase off the rest of Gai's fleet. Then land on <planet> and check up on House Unuk.

children.key: As you begin your landing approach towards the spaceport, you see fire spread amongst the trees near the location of House Unuk in the Zuba Fahn mountains. And above the mountains are several Shield Beetles, a Solifuge, and a new ship that you assume must be the Sword Scorpion the elders warned you about. The ships are beginning their ascent. You cancel the autopilot's landing sequence and move to pursue them.

The ship is lurching erratically as the Unfettered have abandoned their posts to fight off your boarding attempt. An Unfettered you assume is Gai Ro Nin wields a glimmering sword as he attacks one of your crew members. He then turns his attention to you and charges. As he does so, you sense the artificial gravity has begun to fail...
(Wield the terrifying power of Midnight's Lost Orphan.)

You attempt to block the sword with your rifle. He smirks as you do so and you watch in horror as the blade passes through the rifle and into your chest. You feel no pain, as if the sword isn't even there. You aim the rifle at his head and pull the trigger. But like the sword, the laser passes through his head as if he isn't there! Then you notice him manipulate a control on the handle and suddenly there is a sharp pain in your chest. Gai gasps for air as you feel your life slip away. "The only... (gasp) drawback... (gasp) is that I can't breath... (gasp) while phased out," he mutters as he wipes the blood off the blade with your shirt.

You dodge the blade as he careens past you. The artificial gravity has completely failed and you notice him frantically fidgeting with a control on the sword grip when he passes through the bulkhead! You hear an audible squish as his arm holding the sword becomes trapped on your side of the wall. His hand goes limp and releases the sword. Through a nearby view port you see Gai's corpse floating out in the void of space. You manage to grab hold of the Quantum Key Blade and tuck it into your belt. There's still a battle to be fought.
You are the Demon Captain of Atrocities. The power of Midnight's Lost Orphan flows through you. As Gai Ro Nin charges with his sword poised to strike, you gesture at him with murderous intent...

But nothing happens! It's as if Gai isn't there... Gai smirks as he closes in. He plunges the blade deep into your chest, but you feel no pain. As you stare at the blade sticking out of your chest in bewilderment, Gai manipulates something on the sword grip. Sudden pain washes over you as Gai quantum shifts. He takes a deep breath. "The only... (gasp) drawback... (gasp) is that I can't breath... (gasp) while phased out," he mutters as he wipes the blood off the blade with your shirt. As your life slips away, you will Midnight's Lost Orphan to make one final attack against Gai... But it's too late. It seems the entity has abandoned you in favor of a new host. "What's this?" you hear Gai gasp as your vision fades to black."

values: Board the Kotetsu and claim the Quantum Key Blade
The battle still rages on overhead! Drive off the rest of Gai's fleet before returning to the planet's surface.

Finally found Gai Ro Nin and retrieved the Quantum Key Blade. Gai and his crew destroyed House Unuk in order to get their hands on it. The maid who greeted me on my previous visit is the only survivor. I'll hold onto the Quantum Key Blade until she regains consciousness and can answer some questions.

children.key: When you return to the surface you find that a fire suppression team has already put out the forest fire. The only survivor was the maid who greeted you on your previous visit. Unfortunately she hasn't regained consciousness. With nothing else to do, you board your ship with the Quantum Key Blade at your hip.

name: QKBlade: House Unuk History
displayName: Dream Quest of Unuk al Hai
description: Is this reality? Or some kind of fantasy? Better land on <planet> and clear your head.

values: Dream Quest of Unuk al Hai
Is this reality? Or some kind of fantasy? Better land on <planet> and clear your head.

children.key: It has been some time since the day you fought Gai and took hold of the Quantum Key Blade. Now that you've returned to Unukalhai, it might be a good idea to check up on House Unuk.

After hiking through the mountains, you find the Unuk residence has been rebuilt. You try using the communications device at the entrance and a familiar voice answers. You explain why you are visiting.
"Ah, thank you for coming to check up on me! Tell me, what happened to the item?"
You tell her, "After recovering it from the thief, the Hai government allowed me to keep it."

"I suppose that's for the best. I wouldn't want anyone else coming here in search of it. I think it's fair to tell you, I am the master of House Unuk. My ancestors were among the first colonists on Flood. In these mountains, they found and befriended the last surviving descendant of the Hai. According to him, his ancestors crash landed here during a war that took place centuries before, when the stars were different." She pauses then says,"Please wait a moment. There's something I want to show you." She goes back into the house while you wait.

After a short while, she returns with a quantum keystone and a mirror that appears to also be made from a quantum keystone. "These were the other treasures held by the last Hai. Gai never asked for them. Maybe he didn't know they were here." The mirror glimmers under the light of Unukalhai's sun, and you feel light headed...

values: You feel like you aren't yourself. A fleet of what appear to be Hai ships is attacking you! They look slightly different than the ones you are used to. There also seem to be some VERY strange ships accompanying you...
You intercept a Hai communication: "They have cut the Hyperspace connections! Our only hope is a crash landing on Unuk al Hai!"

House Unuk seems satisfied with me keeping the Quantum Key Blade. Their maid has recovered from her injuries and the house has been rebuilt. I also learned some of the history behind the relationship behind House Unuk, the Hai, and Unukalhai. That's all I'm willing to say about that for now.
You contemplate returning to House Unuk, but decide you'd rather not get anywhere near that strange mirror again.

_internalId: Lost In Midnight/Lost-in-Midnight::QKBlade: House Unuk Secrets

name: QKBlade: Bearer of The Blade 1

children.key: When you first arrive, you have some trouble convincing the guards that you have legitimate business with the council. After showing them the Quantum Key Blade, they allow you to enter.
You report to the elders your battle with the Kotetsu and the fate of Gai Ro Nin. At the end you raise up the Quantum Key Blade.

"During your absence, the council decided that, should you desire it, you would be allowed to bear the blade while you live. Know that this permission does not extend to your heirs, and once you pass from this mortal realm the Hai government expects the blade to be returned," decrees one elder.
"Will you bear this burden?" asks another elder."
"I accept. Thank you for this honor."
"Thank you, but I am unworthy of this honor."

values: I have returned the Quantum Key Blade to the Hai people. I believe that is where the artifact truly belongs.

children.key: "It is in the best interest of everyone that the blade is returned to the Hai people." The elders accept the blade's return. There is a short ceremony where you are honored for your heroic actions.

values: I have accepted the honor and responsibility of carrying the Quantum Key Blade with me on my journey across the stars.

children.key: There is some chattering amongst the elders. Then they address you.

"With this, all five of the Quantum Key Blades are accounted for. As you carry that one on your journeys, word will spread that you are in possession of it. Take care that you do not lose it to any Unfettered assassin who tries to claim it."
As the meeting adjourns, you wonder if you made the right choice.

name: QKBlade: Bearer of The Blade 2

values: event: stolen Quantum Key Blade timer

children.key: A large crowd has gathered at the entrance to the space port. Apparently, one of the Quantum Key Blades was loaned to a local culture festival and has been put on display for a daily show demonstrating its powers. The next showing is supposed to start soon.
An hour pass and the size of the crowd has doubled. The show should have started 20 minutes ago and the security guard in charge of crowd control fidgets nervously.
Finally, one of the festival officials gets in front of the crowd.

"Folks, I apologize for the long wait. Unfortunately, someone has stolen the Quantum Key Blade that was supposed to be on display today! The government has been notified and the perpetrator will be found and punished to the fullest extent of the law!"
"This human has a sword that looks like the Quantum Key Blade!" yells someone near you. The crowd gives you a a wide berth as the festival official tentatively approaches.
"I am Da Soo Un, the organizer of this festival. And you are?"
"Captain Crunch, master of the Milky Way."
"You've been accused of a serious crime. Please give a serious answer."
"Captain <last>, please allow me to take a close look at your sword's hand guard..."
Carefully, you present the sword for inspection.

"The sword that was stolen was the Snake. This sword is the Dragon!" The Quantum Key Blade is handed back to you and you take note of the intricate dragon carving on the hand guard. "Bearer of The Blade, would you be willing to demonstrate the Dragon's powers for the crowd? We have a variety of props on stage for you work with."
"Sure, why not? It'd be a shame for everyone to leave disappointed."
"I would be honored to fulfill such an important role in this cultural event."
To the crowd's delight, you give a quick ten minute demonstration of the blade's abilities and follow up with the story of your battle with Gai Ro Nin and how you came to be a bearer of the blade.

values: A Quantum Key Blade referred to as the "Snake" was stolen from a Hai cultural festival. My own Quantum Key Blade was referred to as the "Dragon". It does have an intricate carving of a dragon on the hand guard.

children.key: While walking through the space port you find yourself surrounded by a group of thugs armed with energy blasters.
"Hands ovah youse cash and no one gets 'urt," commands one of them.
You draw the Quantum Key Blade out from its sheath.
"Oh, wheeze gotz a real joker here! Brings a sword to a gun fight. Waste 'em boyz!"
You manage to Quantum shift just as the first energy bolt reaches you. After half a minute of constant blasting, the smoke clears and you glare at them.
"Holy sh... Wait. Dat sword! It's just like the one Phantom uses! Dis ain't no easy mark! Every man for himself!" The thugs scatter.

You want to pursue but first you need to disengage Quantum mode. As soon as you do, you gasp for air. Not being able to breath while it's activated is a severe drawback of using this weapon. You wonder who this Phantom person is as you head back to your ship.

values: Someone amongst the pirates who goes by the name "Phantom" seems to be wielding a Quantum Key Blade.

Your attack passes harmlessly through her as she shifts back into Quantum mode. What will you do?

You deftly dodge Phantom's attack and she loses her balance. She tries to shift out of Quantum mode but is already halfway into the ground when she does so. You hear an audible squelch as her lower torso is melded into the ground. She lets out a pained groan before vomiting out blood as she passes away. Her hand goes limp as her Quantum Key Blade falls to the ground. When you pick up the blade, you note the intricate snake carving on the hand guard.

In the heat of battle mistakes can and will occur. As you shift back into Quantum mode her blade sinks into you, confirming this fundamental truth. "Thank you for saving me the trouble of having to shift back," she whispers into your ear. The blow is fatal and you fall through the ground, leaving only your blade behind...
You are the Demon Captain of Atrocities. The power of Midnight's Lost Orphan flows through you. As Phantom charges with her sword poised to strike, you gesture at her with murderous intent...

children.key: The council of elders is surprised and delighted that you managed to locate and return the stolen Quantum Key Blade to them.
"To think that an Alpha got ahold of it! We must tighten the security on these artifacts," exclaims one elder.
"Funding will be granted to the Museum of Galactic History for this purpose," replies another elder.
"Once again, Captain <first> <last>, you have proven your friendship to the Hai," states a third elder.
"A reward of <payment> for the return of the blade was planned, but we will just deposit that to your account."

children.key: It's late at night and a thunderstorm rages overhead. While watching the blades of lightning slice through the clouds, you recall that the other four Quantum Key Blades are secured by the Museum of Galactic History here on Mirrorlake. A malicious thought occurs to you. Do you want to steal them? Doing so would probably irrepairably damage your relationship with the Hai...
(Uphold the trust the Hai have placed in you.)
(Uphold the trust the Hai have placed in you.)
(Betray the trust of the Hai and take the remaining blades.)

With your own Quantum Key Blade, you hop into a passing supply truck and ride into the facility. You evade security, walking through several walls and find the chamber where the other Quantum Key Blades are stored. The strange twisted display stand has an empty slot for your own blade to rest in...
(Place your own blade on the stand.)
The display is complete. Your own blade shines brightly at the center, a shining symbol of the trust the Hai have placed in you...

You help yourself to all the blades. Getting out is as easy as sneaking in. Unfortunately, while Quantum phasing allows you to walk through walls, it does not render you invisible. The security systems provide evidence that you are responsible for the theft and you are no longer welcomed by the Hai.
You banish these malicious thoughts from your mind and choose to uphold the trust the Hai have placed in you.
With some effort, you banish these tempting thoughts from your mind and choose to uphold the trust the Hai have placed in you.
Retrieving back the Quantum Dragon Blade, you renew your determination to honor your friendship with the Hai. You depart the chamber as the Bearer of the Blade.

values: Quantum Key Blades are amazing weapons. After some consideration, I decided to betray the trust the Hai have placed in me and take the remaining Quantum Key Blades for my own use.

children.key: This is no small job. The CEO of Syndicated Systems will be riding an Executive Guard, a powerful warship the Syndicate reserves for use only by corporate VIPs.
You've captured the CEO of Syndicated Systems! Return to <destination> where he'll be held for ransom.

You present the CEO to the pirates. They are in awe of your accomplishment. A few warlords confide to you that this job was only intended as a joke and they never actually expected anyone to pull it off.

Despite this, the pirates are able to negotiate with the Syndicate. The CEO is easily ransomed off for the requested amount. You claim your share of the ransom money, <payment>. Naturally, this stunt has made you an enemy of the Syndicate. Their security forces will be looking to collect bonus pay for your head.

description: Bring <fare> to <destination>. Payment is <payment>.

children.key: This client looks somewhat familiar, but you're not sure where you've seen her before. After studying your face for a moment she asks,"Are you Captain <last>?"
"That's me. But have we met before?"
"I'm Erin. Erin Burnbeck! I'm pretty sure you're the same captain that helped my family get back home after the war started. Those were scary times..."

You remember transporting the Burnbecks back during those early days of the war. Shirley and Darren were worried for their family back then. But seeing Erin all grown up now is a reminder that a lot has happened since then.
"Yup!" She beams with pride, "I got a teaching job at the Conservatory there." Ijs and Katya set up that institution.

name: Midnight Poker
description: "Ongoing poker game at the bar. Serious players only." Might be a chance to get some easy credits, or lose them...

values: "Ongoing poker game at the bar. Serious players only." Might be a chance to get some easy credits, or lose them...

children.key: You find the group of poker players at the bar.
Everyone addss 10,000 credits to the pot. The cards are shuffled and dealt out...
After exchanging some cards to improve your hand, you wind up with junk. You could raise 10,000 more credits and try to bluff your way to a win, but the odds are against you...
You forfeit this round. Play again?
As expected, one of the other players has a better hand than you.
Luckily, everyone else decided to fold and you win with the high card! You gain 50,000 credits.
After exchanging some cards to improve your hand, you wind up with a single pair. You could raise 10,000 more credits and try to bluff your way to a win, but the odds are against you...
Unfortunately, one of the other players has a better hand than you.
Luckily, everyone else decided to fold and you win with a single pair! You gain 50,000 credits.
After exchanging some cards to improve your hand, you wind up with two pairs. You could raise 10,000 more credits and try to bluff your way to a win, but the odds are against you...
Unfortunately, one of the other players has a better hand than you.
Amazingly, everyone's hand was worse and you win with two pairs! You gain 80,000 credits.
After exchanging some cards to improve your hand, you wind up with three of a kind. It's a decent hand, but there are stronger ones. You could raise 10,000 more credits or play it safe with a call...
"Call." (try to win with the current bet.)
Unfortunately, one of the other players has a better hand than you.
Luckily, everyone else decided to fold and you win with three of a kind! You gain 50,000 credits.
Unfortunately, one of the other players has a better hand than you.
Luckily, everyone's hand was worse and you win with three of a kind! You gain 40,000 credits.
After exchanging some cards to improve your hand, you wind up with a straight. It's a decent hand, but there are stronger ones. You could raise 10,000 more credits or play it safe with a call...
"Call." (try to win with the current bet.)
Unfortunately, one of the other players has a better hand than you.
Luckily, everyone else decided to fold and you win with a straight! You gain 50,000 credits.
Unfortunately, one of the other players has a better hand than you.
Luckily, everyone's hand was worse and you win with a straight! You gain 40,000 credits.
After exchanging some cards to improve your hand, you wind up with a flush. It's a strong hand. You could raise 10,000 more credits or play it safe with a call...
"Call." (try to win with the current bet.)
Unfortunately, one of the other players has a better hand than you.
Luckily, someone took the bait and you win with a flush! You gain 60,000 credits.
Unfortunately, one of the other players has a better hand than you.
Luckily, everyone's hand was worse and you win with a flush! You gain 40,000 credits.
Unfortunately no one took the bait, but you still win with a flush! You gain 50,000 credits.
After exchanging some cards to improve your hand, you wind up with a full house. It's a strong hand. You could raise 10,000 more credits or play it safe with a call...
"Call." (try to win with the current bet.)
Unfortunately, one of the other players has a better hand than you.
Luckily, someone took the bait and you win with a full house! You gain 60,000 credits.

Unfortunately no one took the bait, but you still win with a full house! You gain 50,000 credits.
After exchanging some cards to improve your hand, you wind up with four of a kind. It's a strong hand. You could raise 10,000 more credits or play it safe with a call...
"Call." (try to win with the current bet.)
Unfortunately, one of the other players has a better hand than you.
Luckily, someone took the bait and you win with four of a kind! You gain 60,000 credits.
Unfortunately, one of the other players has a better hand than you.
Luckily, everyone's hand was worse and you win with four of a kind! You gain 40,000 credits.
Unfortunately no one took the bait, but you still win with four of a kind! You gain 50,000 credits.
After exchanging some cards to improve your hand, you wind up with a straight flush. It's a strong hand. You could raise 10,000 more credits or play it safe with a call...
"Call." (try to win with the current bet.)
Unfortunately, one of the other players has a better hand than you.
Luckily, someone took the bait and you win with a straight flush! You gain 60,000 credits.
Amazingly, one of the other players has a royal flush.
As expected, everyone's hand was worse and you win with a straight flush! You gain 40,000 credits.
Unfortunately no one took the bait, but you still win with a straight flush! You gain 50,000 credits.
After exchanging some cards to improve your hand, you wind up with a royal flush! It's an unbeatable hand. You could raise 10,000 more credits or play it safe with a call...
"Call." (try to win with the current bet.)
Luckily, someone took the bait and you win with a royal flush! You gain 60,000 credits.
As expected, everyone's hand was worse and you win with a royal flush! You gain 40,000 credits.
Unfortunately no one took the bait, but you still win with a royal flush! You gain 50,000 credits.
The other players have had enough and leave you with your winnings.
Unfortunately, you don't have enough credits to continue playing. "Better luck next time!" They continue without you.

The other players have had enough and leave you with your winnings. Mixed into the pile of credit chips is a data drive. It contains a map pointing to the western region of the Dirt Belt and a transmission code. There are instruction to transmit the code at either Gacrux or Minkar to access a hidden system.
Looks like at least one of the poker players was upset that you did too well at the card table.
